objects.prompt: Pixel art computer desk setup, front view, straight-on camera angle. A very cheap improvised desk made from an old rusty metal barrel found in the trash, repurposed as a makeshift computer desk. On top is an old basic Windows desktop PC setup with a small outdated monitor, cheap keyboard and mouse. Visible desktop PC tower next to the barrel, old and slightly worn. Messy cables, low-budget improvised appearance, slightly beat-up equipment.  Centered composition, full setup visible from the front, isolated object, detailed retro pixel art, consistent proportions, transparent background.  IMPORTANT: NO CHAIR, NO STOOL, NO SEATING, NO PERSON. Only the desk/barrel and computer equipment.
